description: PHP framework for the Telegram Bot API: typed API client for every Bot API method, routing, middleware, conversations, webhooks, long polling, a tgbot CLI and a BotTester testing kit.
rules: Build handlers on TGbotPHP\Framework\Bot: command(), hears(), callback(), inlineQuery(), state() and onUpdate(). Every handler receives the update payload first, then the Bot, then the data of the route.
Read the bot token from the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable or from TGbotPHP\Core\Config, and keep it out of the source code.
Escape user-controlled text with TGbotPHP\Utilities\Formatter::escape() before sending it in HTML parse mode.
Upload local files with TGbotPHP\Types\InputFile; a plain string is sent as a file_id or as a URL.
Pass the optional parameters of a Bot API method in the trailing array $options, using the names from the official Telegram documentation.
Use TGbotPHP\Core\Config and its with*() methods for timeouts, retries, debug logging and webhook limits; the object is immutable.
Use TGbotPHP\Testing\BotTester and TGbotPHP\Testing\FakeUpdate to test handlers without network access.
Run webhooks with $bot->handle() and long polling with $bot->poll(); handle() never retries API calls so the worker can answer Telegram.
